_meta.name: Bridge Design System
_meta.governance: Tier 1 primitives feed Tier 2 semantic aliases and Tier 3 component overrides.
_meta.visualDirection: Pleasure Pass foundations: deliberate palette and numeric typography change; brand identity and financial reservation preserved.

layout._radius: Radius communicates hierarchy: surface for page-level surfaces, control for buttons, inputs and menus, compact for small inline objects, pill only for status.

effects._glassmorphism: Glass is reserved for navigation and control chrome; content surfaces stay opaque.
effects._elevation: raised separates content from the canvas by tone with a faint shadow; overlay is for chrome, menus and dialogs that float above content.
effects._glow: One restrained brand glow for setup, empty and success moments only.
effects._motion: fast for control feedback, standard for UI transitions, spatial for movement across the layout. Animate transform and opacity only.
